weightage_source: Shopper survey of pre-purchase checks and most-useful features. Not a Myntra funnel or WPC rate, and not computed from public VOC.
note: Segments are purchase intents, not age bands. Maximum weightage in the survey is 75% (Size & Fit, and Wishlist comparison). Survey % is stated intent/check behaviour. VOC mentions size related public-review blockers in this corpus only.

segments.name: Personalised Size & Fit Confidence
segments.primary_need: Confirm the garment will fit this body before buying
segments.main_barrier: Fit and size doubt on the PDP / wishlist
survey_evidence: 31.3% chose this as the most useful feature
segments.conversion_hypothesis: Moving users from 3/5 to 4/5 purchase intent by confirming fit visually. Hypothesis from the survey, not a measured lift.
ai_solutions: Virtual try-on overlay from a user photo
Smart size recommendation from measurements and purchase history
Cluster real customer photos by body type
Pin review videos that mention fit/size

segments.name: Genuine Customer Reviews & Social Proof
segments.primary_need: Trust that the product is real and looks as shown
segments.main_barrier: Doubt about authenticity, quality, and whose reviews to believe
survey_evidence: 25% say genuine reviews would most increase confidence
18.8% chose real customer proof as the most useful new feature
segments.conversion_hypothesis: Surface verified, similar-shopper proof so people do not leave for Reddit. Hypothesis from the survey, not a measured lift.
ai_solutions: AI review summary card (quality, fit, value)

segments.name: Wishlist Comparison & Decision Engine
segments.primary_need: Pick one item from a shortlist without leaving the app
segments.main_barrier: Choice overload and off-platform price/product comparison
survey_evidence: 75% add items to wishlist specifically to compare alternatives
43.8% want to save items for later consideration
25% chose wishlist comparison as the most useful new feature
18.8% compare with other products on Myntra
segments.conversion_hypothesis: A side-by-side compare plus a best-pick score reduces stall on a 3/5 shortlist. Hypothesis from the survey, not a measured lift.
ai_solutions: AI best-pick score on the shortlist
Smart grouping by occasion, style, or duplicate need

segments.name: Return Policy Confidence & Inventory Clarity
segments.primary_need: Know it is easy to return and that the saved size is still buyable
segments.main_barrier: Fear of painful returns and unclear stock/price on the wishlist
survey_evidence: 56.3% check the return/exchange policy before purchasing
segments.conversion_hypothesis: Visible return window plus OOS/price-drop handling keeps the wishlist actionable. Hypothesis from the survey, not a measured lift.
ai_solutions: Separate out-of-stock items from actionable wishlist rows
